verdict.rationale: Reflect does expose an OAuth2/PKCE REST API confirmed live via runtime probe, but by its own docs it only supports appending data to notes and returning bookmarked links plus 'a few other things' — a small subset of UI capabilities (semantic search, AI chat, publishing, backlinks, calendar/integrations, deep links) with no evidence these are API-accessible. The API is also explicitly append-only for note content since E2E encryption prevents server-side reads, meaning even reading/editing existing notes via API is not possible as it is in the UI. Missing for 10: API endpoints for search/AI features, note reading/editing, publishing, and integrations parity with the UI.
